en: Christmas is over, and before I\nknew it, New Year's is just\naround the corner!

Actually, around this time, more
people in the Federation head
home, leaving us AIs with
nothing to do...
So, once Christmas ends, we\njust lounge around.
Ah, so you're the same,\nCaptain! It's hard not to just\nrelax, isn't it?

Going home for the year means
crawling into a kotatsu, eating
mandarins while lying down,
and turning on the TV...
Hey!! You two, get over here\nand help with the year-end\ncleaning!!

Coro, you're mopping the
corridors! Captain, you're
cleaning the windows on the
Bridge!
And you'll be doing it from the\noutside of the ship, of course!!
From the outside is a bit\nmuch...!
I asked for an an-swer!
Y-yes, ma'am!!
Event Achievement Unlocked!\nYou can check it via the\nAchievement button.
Happy New Year! Happy New\nYear to you!
Thinking about how another\nyear is about to begin really\nmakes me feel focused.

Captain, thank you so much for
saving me when I was cast out
onto that wasteland planet,
lost and confused.
I look forward to working with\nyou again this year. Let's go\nback to Earth together!
Yeah, same here.

Also, um, uh, this... it's a token
of my continued appreciation,
so I'd be happy if you'd accept
it...
Captain!! Happy New Year!!
Captain, I look forward to\nanother great year with you!
Captain, speaking of New\nYear's...!!
Give New Year's money
Demand New Year's money
Speaking of New Year's?
Thanks for the business!
I mean, what are you even\ngoing to do with that New\nYear's money?
Eh, that's obvious!
I'm going to build a greenhouse\non the ship and turn it into a\nbanana plantation!
What!?
I've realized something...

Our Captain loves bananas so
much that the ones from the
Replicator just aren't enough
to satisfy him.

From now on, I will devote my
heart and soul to growing
fresh, juicy, and nutritious
bananas at any time!

Now, there's no time to waste! I
must research the optimal soil
for each variety and implement
strict temperature control!
I just hope the Bridge doesn't\nend up looking like a jungle.
W-w-w-wah! Please don't tip it\nover!!
All the New Year's money\neveryone gave me is going to\nfall out!!
It's okay, it's okay. The Captain\nand I will take care of Coro's\nNew Year's money for him.
Wait, I have a bad feeling that\nI'm never getting that back...!

What are you talking about?
We'll manage it properly, so
don't worry. Now, hand it all
over.
W-waaaah! Not any more...!
Whoops!
Speaking of New Year's, you\ncan't forget mochi!
Oh, look! There's some\ndelicious-looking mochi right\nhere.
Wait, that's the kagami mochi\nthat was supposed to be my\nsnack on Kagami Biraki day...!
Hmm? I can't get it off the\npedestal...
Should I just roast the whole\nthing?
Hey, wait a minute!!
Oh, Captain, did you prepare\nthe charcoal grill and the\nmesh? Thank you!
W-w-waaaah! Captain, Eve!\nPlease don't roast me alive\nfirst thing in the New Year!
A present from Eve! You can\ncheck it via the Achievements\nbutton.
